provenance.caveat: Claude Code starts a subagent from the main agent's own Agent tool. No transport that lets the harness start one from its own process, and hand back a handle, has been verified.
No way for the harness to read a running subagent's state has been verified.
No way for the harness to send a message to a running subagent has been verified.
No way for the harness to stop a running subagent has been verified.
Subagent lifecycle hooks have not been verified as an event stream the harness can read.

notes: A `claude -p` process is a separate session, not a subagent of the current one; it is not a substitute for `start`.
